gaps.old_draft_snippet: Physics-informed diffractive neural networks can approximate the inverse transmission matrix of speckle patterns to enable high-speed all-optical decryption of ciphertexts in real-time, eliminating the computational latency caused by optoelectronic conversion
gaps.scientific_content: The specific application of physics-informed diffractive networks for all-optical speckle decryption (approximating the inverse transmission matrix) is missing. gaps.old_draft_snippet: Hybrid optical-electronic convolutional neural networks utilize optimized diffractive optics where color-sensitive kernels are employed to manage spectral information, often requiring narrow bandpass filters for monochromatic imaging at the cost of color data
